mapper.select: SELECT SEQCATEGORY AS seqCategory, CATEGORYNAME AS categoryName, SORTORDER AS sortOrder, USEYN AS useYn FROM BOARD_CATEGORY WHERE USEYN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORTORDER ASC, SEQCATEGORY ASC

SELECT SEQBOARDPOST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO BOARD_POST ( SEQBOARDPOST, SEQCATEGORY, SEQMEMBER, TITLE, CONTENT, VIEWCOUNT, STATUS, CREATEDATE ) VALUES ( #{seqBoardPost}, #{seqCategory}, #{seqMember}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 'NORMAL', SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO board_post_file ( seqBoardPostFile, seqBoardPost, originalName, savedName, filePath, fileSize, fileType, createDate ) VALUES ( SEQBOARDPOSTFILE.NEXTVAL, #{seqBoardPost}, #{originalName}, #{savedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT bp.seqBoardPost, bp.seqCategory AS seqCategory, bp.seqMember, bp.title, bp.content, bp.viewCount, bp.status, TO_CHAR(bp.createDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createDate, TO_CHAR(bp.updateDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updateDate, bc.categoryName, m.nickname AS writerNickname, m.name AS writerName FROM board_post bp INNER JOIN board_category bc ON bp.seqCategory = bc.seqCategory INNER JOIN member m ON bp.seqMember = m.seqMember WHERE bp.seqBoardPost = #{seqBoardPost} AND bp.status = 'NORMAL'

SELECT seqBoardPostFile, seqBoardPost, originalName, savedName, fileSize, fileType, TO_CHAR(createDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createDate FROM board_post_file WHERE seqBoardPost = #{seqBoardPost} ORDER BY seqBoardPostFile ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE board_post SET seqCategory = #{seqCategory}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updateDate = SYSDATE WHERE seqBoardPost = #{seqBoardPost}
UPDATE board_post SET status = 'DELETED', updateDate = SYSDATE WHERE seqBoardPost = #{seqBoardPost}
